svg.title: Device Recovery Lab
svg.desc: Did it happen? I built a recovery service for a simulated locker. I use controlled failures to test what it can establish before it resends a command. The drawing shows two captured controller crashes: before the pulse the locker stays closed with 0 physical pulses, after the pulse it is open with 1, and both controller journals read IN_DOUBT.
